method: No grades: every line below is a phrase from the phrase book (engine/battle/phrasebook.json), triggered by numbers the engine measures, the way the games turn a Pokémon's best IV into its characteristic. Speed, power and bulk are measured against every fully evolved Pokémon of the same generation. Opponents' philosophy comes from the game's own trainer AI flags, bag and battle lines. Every one-on-one is played out by the scouting engine (docs/SCOUTING_ENGINE.md): our best plan against their best answer, Smogon's calculator for every hit at the lowest roll, every move landing, the odds kept. Against a game's trainers we meet them at their top level; the coach profile is measured against that generation's Smogon OU usage field at Lv 100.

league.rules: Lv 100, Gen 4 rules, IVs 31, EVs 85 in every stat unless recorded, builds as recorded; each one-on-one played out by the scouting engine
